**[P2] Apply accepted response state before suspending**

This exits before merging `NewExecutionState` or emitting plugin updates. The checkpoint batch was accepted, so inline terminal operation states are omitted from the invocation-end snapshot and operation-end hooks; if the service simultaneously failed the execution, there may be no later invocation to recover them. Merge the inline operations without pagination and emit their updates before suspending waiters. Add plugin/OTel coverage for this path.
